headline: Disney Plus app on Meta Quest adds more than 60 3D movies
summary: The Disney Plus app on Meta Quest was updated to include more than 60 3D movies, such as The Avengers and Black Panther. Outlets differ on whether the films are bundled for subscribers or sold separately by Meta.

claims.statement: The Disney Plus app on Meta Quest now includes 3D movies.

sources.quote: The Disney+ app on Meta Quest now includes 3D movies
The VR Disney Plus app on Meta Quest now has 3D movies

claims.statement: Disney is bringing more than 60 3D movies, including The Avengers and Black Panther, to the app in an update rolling out today.

sources.quote: Disney is bringing more than 60 3D movies to the Disney Plus app on Meta Quest.
The 3D movies you can check out include The Avengers and Black Panther, Meta says.

discrepancies.explanation: One outlet frames the update as Meta beginning to sell 3D films, while another describes the films as available to Disney Plus subscribers.

quotes.quote: Meta is starting to sell 3D films too.
The movies will be available to Disney Plus subscribers as part of an updated Disney Plus app that's rolling out today.
